reasons: Admitted on the vendor's own fetched documentation; this application has not run a live key gate against this endpoint.
Subscription (plan) credential: usage is metered against plan quota, not per-token list prices, so models on this row carry no `pricing`.

The key and Base URL are issued per subscription and the account region must match the cluster (https://mimo.mi.com/docs/en-US/quick-start/faq/token-plan/Team-Benefits); a key is not documented to work on another cluster's host.
The vendor's OpenAI-dialect reasoning replay contract must not be assumed for Anthropic Messages without a dialect-specific document or probe.

admission.citation: https://mimo.mi.com/docs/en-US/tokenplan/Token%20Plan/quick-access — Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan quick access, retrieved 2026-09-25: the Singapore cluster (international default) serves OpenAI-compatible `https://token-plan-sgp.xiaomimimo.com/v1` and Anthropic-compatible `https://token-plan-sgp.xiaomimimo.com/anthropic`; after subscribing the user receives an exclusive `tp-` key and Base URL ("the Base URL shall be subject to what is displayed on the Token Plan page"); billing is the subscription plan.

continuationDomain.sourceRef: BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: https://mimo.mi.com/static/docs/api/chat/anthropic-api.md (read 2026-10-29): `thinking` blocks carry `thinking` and `signature`; "the model returns a `thinking` content block alongside `tool_use` content block. To continue the conversation, it is recommended to keep all previous `thinking` content block in the `messages` array for each subsequent request to achieve the best performance." Why the domain is NARROW: the state is valid only for the model that produced it on this route -- a different model, or the same model at another provider (a different credential and account), never receives it, and the history renderer strips it there.
